== English errata comparison sources ==
The replacement expressly distinguishes capture, seizure by a bounty hunter, and delivery to the prison where Vader is present. The ability threshold, retrieval amount, Luke bonus, and loss and immunity remain. The 2023 Appendix A entry continues on PDF page 133.
